verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street claims an upfront viability assessment ('straight talk on viability') and visa design before filing. Its resource guides touch on individual O-1 criteria, such as references speaking to each criterion and remuneration benchmarks. It does not document a structured method for scoring a founder's evidence against the USCIS O-1A criteria. Missing for 10: a documented, criterion-by-criterion O-1A evaluation methodology, a description of the assessment deliverable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a structured O-1A qualification assessment — the provider documents how it evaluates my extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS criteria before anything is filed

citations.quote: Straight talk on viability and the exact narrative to maximize success.
We design the right visa up front, minimize RFEs
each reference you submit should speak to each of the visa criteria that you meet.
